article.hook: You’re scrolling through facts and opinions faster than you can respond. The North Node in Gemini pulls us into a year and a half of gathering pieces, not locking answers. It’s not about knowing better yet - it’s about knowing more.
article.lived: Over the next eighteen months, questions pile up and conversations multiply in unexpected corners of life. You’ll find yourself juggling fragments of news, contradictory takes, and new interests that distract from the old story. The point isn’t to finish or clarify but to add, compare, and hold more than one version at once. We lean into curiosity as a habit, not a hobby.
article.turn: The trouble starts when chasing every lead turns into noise, and you lose track of what you actually want to say or decide. Collecting every viewpoint can freeze action, leaving ideas unfinished or conversations shallow. You don’t grow by hoarding questions - growth demands choosing which ones to answer and which to leave open.
moves: Pick one conversation this week to ask a question that changes everything it’s about.
Keep a list of conflicting opinions you hear and revisit it after three days.
Practice summarizing your point in two sentences before adding more detail.
